earth_a_spec.summary: Thicker insulating peat mat (0.30 m) over dense, low-excess-ice Nenana glacial till (4% excess ice).

earth_b_spec.summary: 24 cm organic mat + silty active horizon hiding a 46% excess-ice wedge/lens zone from 0.70 m to 2.58 m.

nisar_ablation.held_out_epoch: 2026-11-01 Validated GCOV Freeze-Back Pass (Track 116D CRID P05036)

deep_2050_settlement_constraint_honest_a.honest_finding: NISAR repeat L-band observations reduce 2026 active-layer freeze-back uncertainty by ~35% and pinpoint spatial moisture/freeze-delay hotspots, but reduce 2050 deep thaw-settlement uncertainty by <10% on their own because L-band radar (~24 cm wavelength) cannot directly observe segregated ice lenses below the 0.7 m permafrost table. Pairing NISAR hotspot targeting with ONE 1.8 m core reduces 2050 settlement uncertainty by >70%.

hypotheses_summary.question: Can quality-controlled repeat NISAR observations reveal a distinguishable change signal at Eight Mile Lake?
hypotheses_summary.metric: Mean terrestrial HH drops from -10.9 dB (Sept 2 thaw) to -14.8 dB (Nov 1 freeze) as liquid pore water freezes; 14% of pixels require water/relief/snow masks.

hypotheses_summary.question: Does physics-coupled dielectric separation beat a seasonal sinusoid + linear trend baseline?
hypotheses_summary.metric: Held-out backscatter RMSE improves by 39.3% (0.68 dB vs 1.12 dB sinusoid baseline) by accounting for zero-curtain latent heat arrest.

hypotheses_summary.question: Can two physically plausible subsurfaces fit 2026 observations while predicting divergent 2050 futures?
hypotheses_summary.metric: Earth A and Earth B fit 2026 active-layer evidence within 2 cm (0.66 m vs 0.68 m), yet diverge to 5.4 cm vs 41.2 cm cumulative settlement by 2050 under +2.5 °C.

hypotheses_summary.question: Does NISAR-guided targeted measurement reduce 2050 disagreement better than random or shallow-probe baselines?
hypotheses_summary.metric: Hotspot 1.8 m core cuts 90% CI width by 74.8% (vs 24.6% random baseline, 8.2% shallow probe, and 0.0% optical drone orthomosaic).

hypotheses_summary.question: Do protective engineering intervention rankings flip when subsurface uncertainty is included?
hypotheses_summary.metric: Drainage alone suffices under Earth A (<5 cm settlement) but fails the 15 cm road tolerance under Earth B (31.4 cm); thermosyphon + insulation is required for minimax robustness.
